company.name: Fathom Protocol
company.shortDescription: Fathom Protocol is a decentralized finance (DeFi) platform.
company.description: Fathom Protocol is a comprehensive DeFi platform providing liquidity solutions to both retail and institutional participants. Users can deposit XDC and staked XDC to mint FXD, USD stablecoin, which can be used to gain exposure to yield opportunities through our RWA Vaults and Trade Finance Pools. Crypto and RWA holders can also borrow FXD using their assets as collateral.

productsAndServices.description: A USD-pegged stablecoin minted by depositing XDC as collateral, used for borrowing, lending, and trading within the Fathom ecosystem.
productsAndServices.name: FXD Stablecoin

productsAndServices.description: A decentralized finance platform enabling users to mint FXD stablecoin, deposit assets, borrow FXD, and access liquidity through RWA Vaults and Trade Finance Pools.
productsAndServices.name: Fathom Liquidity Protocol

productsAndServices.description: A governance token that holders can stake to participate in protocol governance, including voting on development, collateral onboarding, and revenue distribution.
productsAndServices.name: FTHM Governance Token

productsAndServices.description: A stableswap decentralized exchange within the Fathom ecosystem for converting FXD stablecoin to other assets and facilitating liquidity.
productsAndServices.name: Fathom DEX

productsAndServices.description: On-chain vaults and pools that allow users to earn yield by staking FXD stablecoin, backed by real-world assets and trade finance instruments.
productsAndServices.name: RWA Vaults and Trade Finance Pools

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,000,000, or 66.67% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $11,000,000 to $22,000,000, a 2x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 3 (-46 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Sperax, Abracadabra.money, Liquity.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
